title: A reading test normed to mean 500
intro:
Illustrative norms, made up for this book. A reading test is normed so that scores in the national norm group are normal with mean 500 and standard deviation 100.

A pupil scores 650. Give the pupil's percentile, P(X ≤ 650), and z-score (four decimals), and the score at the 25th percentile (one decimal).

In the Workbench: **Continuous distribution**, **Normal**, mean 500, standard deviation 100, **Value of interest** 650, **Probability for the quantile** 0.25.
hints: The 25th percentile is μ + z₀.₂₅ σ, with z₀.₂₅ = −0.674.
